user.title: Card Style Studio
user.description: Adds Card Style Studio's settings to this page. The Studio itself is installed as a dashboard resource (HACS, the Marketplace or by hand); this entry only holds its settings.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Card Style Studio is already set up.

init.title: Card Style Studio settings
init.description: Defaults for everyone on this Home Assistant. A user's own choice in the Studio (⚙️ Settings, My Color Palette) still wins.

data_description.on_color: The color a new Icon Color, Accent Color or threshold rule starts from while the entity is on. Studio default: the Studio's own.
data_description.off_color: The same while the entity is off.
